snippet.title: MacAttack | Burgerkill - MSX Gameplay
snippet.description:
Released in 1986 and developed by The Bytebusters, MacAttack is one of many clones of Data East's classic arcade game BurgerTime. Not only this was released in the same year as the official MSX port of BurgerTime in Japan, this is also the only BurgerTime clone for that platform anywhere, let alone in Europe. Eaglesoft handled the distribution in the UK and the Netherlands, while Al Alamiah published this clone in Kuwait.

The only recorded review of MacAttack was in the August 1986 issue of MSX Computing, who gave it a score of 2 out of 3.
